parameters.name: acting_as
parameters.description: Person acting (must exist in ROYALTY_USERS with the right role and branch).

Close Recovery Claim.description: Closes a claim; the unrecovered remainder is waived or otherwise resolved with a closure reason. Demo writeback target.

statements.sql: UPDATE ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_CLAIMS c SET "STATUS" = 'Closed', "CLOSURE_REASON" = {closure_reason:string}, "WAIVED_AMOUNT" = GREATEST(0, c."CONFIRMED_AMOUNT" - COALESCE((SELECT SUM("VERIFIED_AMOUNT") FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_RECOVERIES WHERE "CLAIM_ID" = c."CLAIM_ID"), 0)), "IS_OPEN" = 0, "UPDATED_BY" = {acting_as:string}, "UPDATED_AT" = CONVERT_TIMEZONE('Europe/London', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())::TIMESTAMP_NTZ WHERE c."CLAIM_ID" = {claim_id:string} AND LENGTH(TRIM({closure_reason:string})) > 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_USERS u WHERE u."USER_NAME" = {acting_as:string} AND u."CAN_WRITE" = 'Y' AND u."ROLE" IN ('Finance (Recovery)', 'Claims Owner'))
statements.name: close

statements.sql: INSERT INTO ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_CLAIM_EVENTS SELECT 'CEV-' || UUID_STRING(), c."CLAIM_ID", '', 'Claim closed', '', c."STATUS", {acting_as:string}, (SELECT MAX("ROLE") FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_USERS WHERE "USER_NAME" = {acting_as:string}), COALESCE(c."CONFIRMED_AMOUNT", c."ESTIMATE_AT_DISCOVERY"), c."CURRENCY", '', LEFT({closure_reason:string}, 1900), CONVERT_TIMEZONE('Europe/London', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())::TIMESTAMP_NTZ, CURRENT_DATE(), 1 FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_CLAIMS c WHERE c."CLAIM_ID" = {claim_id:string} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_USERS u WHERE u."USER_NAME" = {acting_as:string} AND u."CAN_WRITE" = 'Y' AND u."ROLE" IN ('Finance (Recovery)', 'Claims Owner'))
statements.name: audit

parameters.name: acting_as
parameters.description: Person acting (must exist in ROYALTY_USERS with the right role and branch).

Confirm Recovery Claim.description: Claims owner records the confirmed claim amount, submission date, payer reference and next follow-up. Demo writeback target.

statements.sql: UPDATE ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_CLAIMS SET "STATUS" = 'Submitted', "CONFIRMED_AMOUNT" = {confirmed_amount:float}, "SUBMISSION_DATE" = TO_DATE({submission_date:string}), "PAYER_REF" = {payer_ref:string}, "NEXT_FOLLOW_UP" = TO_DATE({next_follow_up:string}), "UPDATED_BY" = {acting_as:string}, "UPDATED_AT" = CONVERT_TIMEZONE('Europe/London', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())::TIMESTAMP_NTZ WHERE "CLAIM_ID" = {claim_id:string} AND "STATUS" IN ('Open', 'Confirmed') AND {confirmed_amount:float} > 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_USERS u WHERE u."USER_NAME" = {acting_as:string} AND u."CAN_WRITE" = 'Y' AND u."ROLE" IN ('Claims Owner'))
statements.name: confirm

statements.sql: INSERT INTO ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_CLAIM_EVENTS SELECT 'CEV-' || UUID_STRING(), c."CLAIM_ID", '', 'Claim confirmed & submitted', '', c."STATUS", {acting_as:string}, (SELECT MAX("ROLE") FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_USERS WHERE "USER_NAME" = {acting_as:string}), COALESCE(c."CONFIRMED_AMOUNT", c."ESTIMATE_AT_DISCOVERY"), c."CURRENCY", {payer_ref:string}, LEFT('Follow up ' || {next_follow_up:string}, 1900), CONVERT_TIMEZONE('Europe/London', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())::TIMESTAMP_NTZ, CURRENT_DATE(), 1 FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_CLAIMS c WHERE c."CLAIM_ID" = {claim_id:string} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_USERS u WHERE u."USER_NAME" = {acting_as:string} AND u."CAN_WRITE" = 'Y' AND u."ROLE" IN ('Claims Owner'))
statements.name: audit

parameters.description: Required for Returned and Carry-forward approved.

parameters.name: acting_as
parameters.description: Person acting (must exist in ROYALTY_USERS with the right role and branch).

Controller Decide Case.description: Finance Controller approves the disposition, returns it for more work, or approves a carry-forward (rationale required). Maker–checker: never on a case they submitted. Carry-forwards remain in outstanding source exposure. Demo writeback target.

statements.sql: UPDATE ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_CLOSE_CASES SET "STATUS" = {decision:string}, "CONTROLLER" = {acting_as:string}, "CONTROLLER_RATIONALE" = NULLIF({rationale:string}, ''), "CARRY_FORWARD" = IFF({decision:string} = 'Carry-forward approved', 'Y', 'N'), "IS_OPEN" = IFF({decision:string} = 'Returned', 1, 0), "IS_OVERDUE" = IFF({decision:string} = 'Returned', "IS_OVERDUE", 0), "UPDATED_BY" = {acting_as:string}, "UPDATED_AT" = CONVERT_TIMEZONE('Europe/London', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())::TIMESTAMP_NTZ WHERE "CASE_ID" = {case_id:string} AND "STATUS" = 'Submitted for review' AND {decision:string} IN ('Approved', 'Returned', 'Carry-forward approved') AND ({decision:string} = 'Approved' OR LENGTH(TRIM({rationale:string})) > 0) AND "UPDATED_BY" <> {acting_as:string} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_USERS u WHERE u."USER_NAME" = {acting_as:string} AND u."CAN_WRITE" = 'Y' AND u."ROLE" IN ('Finance Controller') AND (u."BRANCH_SCOPE" = 'ALL' OR CONTAINS(u."BRANCH_SCOPE", (SELECT s."BRANCH" FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_CLOSE_CASES c JOIN ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_STATEMENTS s USING ("STATEMENT_ID") WHERE c."CASE_ID" = {case_id:string}))))
statements.name: decide

statements.sql: INSERT INTO ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_CLOSE_EVENTS SELECT 'EV-' || UUID_STRING(), c."CASE_ID", c."STATEMENT_ID", 'Controller: ' || {decision:string}, '', {decision:string}, {acting_as:string}, (SELECT MAX("ROLE") FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_USERS WHERE "USER_NAME" = {acting_as:string}), c."OBSERVED_AMOUNT", c."OBSERVED_CURRENCY", LEFT(COALESCE(NULLIF({rationale:string}, ''), 'Disposition approved'), 1900), CONVERT_TIMEZONE('Europe/London', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())::TIMESTAMP_NTZ, CURRENT_DATE(), 1 FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_CLOSE_CASES c WHERE c."CASE_ID" = {case_id:string} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_USERS u WHERE u."USER_NAME" = {acting_as:string} AND u."CAN_WRITE" = 'Y' AND u."ROLE" IN ('Finance Controller') AND (u."BRANCH_SCOPE" = 'ALL' OR CONTAINS(u."BRANCH_SCOPE", (SELECT s."BRANCH" FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_CLOSE_CASES c JOIN ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_STATEMENTS s USING ("STATEMENT_ID") WHERE c."CASE_ID" = {case_id:string}))))
statements.name: audit

Dismiss Candidate.description: Dismisses an apparent underpayment with a reason (recorded as a dismissed claim so it leaves the queue with an audit trail). Demo writeback target.

statements.sql: INSERT INTO ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_CLAIMS SELECT {claim_id:string}, l."SOURCE_LINE_ID", l."SOURCE_LINE_ID", l."SONG", l."BRANCH", l."ACCOUNTING_PERIOD", l."PAYER", l."INCOME_TYPE", l."CURRENCY", 'Dismissed', l."ESTIMATED_GAP_LOCAL", NULL, NULL, '', NULL, {acting_as:string}, NULL, '', {reason:string}, '', 0, {acting_as:string}, CONVERT_TIMEZONE('Europe/London', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())::TIMESTAMP_NTZ, {acting_as:string}, CONVERT_TIMEZONE('Europe/London', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())::TIMESTAMP_NTZ, 0, 1 FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_PVC_LINES l WHERE l."SOURCE_LINE_ID" = {source_line_id:string} AND LENGTH(TRIM({reason:string})) > 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_USERS u WHERE u."USER_NAME" = {acting_as:string} AND u."CAN_WRITE" = 'Y' AND u."ROLE" IN ('Income Tracking Analyst', 'Claims Owner'))

statements.sql: INSERT INTO ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_CLAIM_EVENTS SELECT 'CEV-' || UUID_STRING(), c."CLAIM_ID", '', 'Candidate dismissed', '', c."STATUS", {acting_as:string}, (SELECT MAX("ROLE") FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_USERS WHERE "USER_NAME" = {acting_as:string}), c."ESTIMATE_AT_DISCOVERY", c."CURRENCY", {source_line_id:string}, LEFT({reason:string}, 1900), CONVERT_TIMEZONE('Europe/London', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())::TIMESTAMP_NTZ, CURRENT_DATE(), 1 FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_CLAIMS c WHERE c."CLAIM_ID" = {claim_id:string} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_USERS u WHERE u."USER_NAME" = {acting_as:string} AND u."CAN_WRITE" = 'Y' AND u."ROLE" IN ('Income Tracking Analyst', 'Claims Owner'))

Open Close Case.description: Opens (and assigns) a close exception case on a verified StatementId, snapshotting the observed source amount, currency and reconciliation flag. Royalty Analyst with branch access only. Demo writeback target.

statements.sql: INSERT INTO ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_CLOSE_CASES SELECT {case_id:string}, s."STATEMENT_ID", {exception_type:string}, 'Assigned', {owner:string}, TO_DATE({due_date:string}), s."SOURCE_EXPOSURE", s."CURRENCY", s."IS_RECONCILED", NULLIF({notes:string}, ''), '', '', '', '', 'N', IFF(TO_DATE({due_date:string}) < '2026-11-11', 1, 0), 1, {acting_as:string}, CONVERT_TIMEZONE('Europe/London', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())::TIMESTAMP_NTZ, {acting_as:string}, CONVERT_TIMEZONE('Europe/London', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())::TIMESTAMP_NTZ, 1 FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_STATEMENTS s WHERE s."STATEMENT_ID" = {statement_id:string} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_CLOSE_CASES x WHERE x."STATEMENT_ID" = s."STATEMENT_ID" AND x."IS_OPEN" = 1) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_USERS u WHERE u."USER_NAME" = {acting_as:string} AND u."CAN_WRITE" = 'Y' AND u."ROLE" IN ('Royalty Analyst') AND (u."BRANCH_SCOPE" = 'ALL' OR CONTAINS(u."BRANCH_SCOPE", (SELECT "BRANCH" FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_STATEMENTS WHERE "STATEMENT_ID" = {statement_id:string}))))
statements.name: open

statements.sql: INSERT INTO ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_CLOSE_EVENTS SELECT 'EV-' || UUID_STRING(), c."CASE_ID", c."STATEMENT_ID", 'Case opened & assigned', '', 'Assigned', {acting_as:string}, (SELECT MAX("ROLE") FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_USERS WHERE "USER_NAME" = {acting_as:string}), c."OBSERVED_AMOUNT", c."OBSERVED_CURRENCY", LEFT('Owner ' || {owner:string} || ', due ' || {due_date:string}, 1900), CONVERT_TIMEZONE('Europe/London', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())::TIMESTAMP_NTZ, CURRENT_DATE(), 1 FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_CLOSE_CASES c WHERE c."CASE_ID" = {case_id:string} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_USERS u WHERE u."USER_NAME" = {acting_as:string} AND u."CAN_WRITE" = 'Y' AND u."ROLE" IN ('Royalty Analyst') AND (u."BRANCH_SCOPE" = 'ALL' OR CONTAINS(u."BRANCH_SCOPE", (SELECT "BRANCH" FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_STATEMENTS WHERE "STATEMENT_ID" = {statement_id:string}))))
statements.name: audit

Open Recovery Claim.description: Turns an apparent underpayment into a claim: captures source-line references, estimate at discovery, owner, due date and evidence. Demo writeback target.

statements.sql: INSERT INTO ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_CLAIMS SELECT {claim_id:string}, {source_line_refs:string}, l."SOURCE_LINE_ID", l."SONG", l."BRANCH", l."ACCOUNTING_PERIOD", l."PAYER", l."INCOME_TYPE", l."CURRENCY", 'Open', l."ESTIMATED_GAP_LOCAL", NULL, NULL, '', NULL, {owner:string}, TO_DATE({due_date:string}), {evidence:string}, '', '', 0, {acting_as:string}, CONVERT_TIMEZONE('Europe/London', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())::TIMESTAMP_NTZ, {acting_as:string}, CONVERT_TIMEZONE('Europe/London', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())::TIMESTAMP_NTZ, 1, 1 FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_PVC_LINES l WHERE l."SOURCE_LINE_ID" = {source_line_id:string} AND l."UNDERPAID_FLAG" = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_CLAIMS c WHERE c."PRIMARY_SOURCE_LINE_ID" = l."SOURCE_LINE_ID" AND c."STATUS" <> 'Dismissed') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_USERS u WHERE u."USER_NAME" = {acting_as:string} AND u."CAN_WRITE" = 'Y' AND u."ROLE" IN ('Income Tracking Analyst', 'Claims Owner'))
statements.name: open

statements.sql: INSERT INTO ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_CLAIM_EVENTS SELECT 'CEV-' || UUID_STRING(), c."CLAIM_ID", '', 'Claim opened', '', c."STATUS", {acting_as:string}, (SELECT MAX("ROLE") FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_USERS WHERE "USER_NAME" = {acting_as:string}), c."ESTIMATE_AT_DISCOVERY", c."CURRENCY", {source_line_id:string}, LEFT('Estimate at discovery; evidence ' || {evidence:string}, 1900), CONVERT_TIMEZONE('Europe/London', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())::TIMESTAMP_NTZ, CURRENT_DATE(), 1 FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_CLAIMS c WHERE c."CLAIM_ID" = {claim_id:string} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_USERS u WHERE u."USER_NAME" = {acting_as:string} AND u."CAN_WRITE" = 'Y' AND u."ROLE" IN ('Income Tracking Analyst', 'Claims Owner'))
statements.name: audit

parameters.name: acting_as
parameters.description: Person acting (must exist in ROYALTY_USERS with the right role and branch).

Record Recovery.description: Finance records a partial or full recovery against a receipt or adjustment. Evidence is required for it to count; a reference can be allocated only once. Demo writeback target.

statements.sql: INSERT INTO ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_RECOVERIES SELECT {recovery_id:string}, c."CLAIM_ID", {amount:float}, c."CURRENCY", r."REF_TYPE", r."RECEIPT_REF", {evidence:string}, IFF(LENGTH(TRIM({evidence:string})) > 0, 'Y', 'N'), IFF(LENGTH(TRIM({evidence:string})) > 0, {acting_as:string}, ''), CONVERT_TIMEZONE('Europe/London', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())::TIMESTAMP_NTZ, {acting_as:string}, CONVERT_TIMEZONE('Europe/London', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())::TIMESTAMP_NTZ, IFF(LENGTH(TRIM({evidence:string})) > 0, 1, 0), IFF(LENGTH(TRIM({evidence:string})) > 0, {amount:float}, 0), 1 FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_CLAIMS c JOIN ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_RECEIPTS r ON r."RECEIPT_REF" = {supporting_ref:string} AND r."CURRENCY" = c."CURRENCY" WHERE c."CLAIM_ID" = {claim_id:string} AND c."STATUS" IN ('Submitted', 'Partially recovered') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_RECOVERIES x WHERE x."SUPPORTING_REF" = {supporting_ref:string}) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_USERS u WHERE u."USER_NAME" = {acting_as:string} AND u."CAN_WRITE" = 'Y' AND u."ROLE" IN ('Finance (Recovery)'))
statements.name: record

statements.sql: UPDATE ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_CLAIMS c SET "STATUS" = IFF((SELECT SUM("VERIFIED_AMOUNT") FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_RECOVERIES WHERE "CLAIM_ID" = c."CLAIM_ID") >= c."CONFIRMED_AMOUNT", 'Recovered', 'Partially recovered'), "UPDATED_BY" = {acting_as:string}, "UPDATED_AT" = CONVERT_TIMEZONE('Europe/London', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())::TIMESTAMP_NTZ WHERE c."CLAIM_ID" = {claim_id:string} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_USERS u WHERE u."USER_NAME" = {acting_as:string} AND u."CAN_WRITE" = 'Y' AND u."ROLE" IN ('Finance (Recovery)'))
statements.name: status

statements.sql: INSERT INTO ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_CLAIM_EVENTS SELECT 'CEV-' || UUID_STRING(), c."CLAIM_ID", '', 'Recovery recorded', '', c."STATUS", {acting_as:string}, (SELECT MAX("ROLE") FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_USERS WHERE "USER_NAME" = {acting_as:string}), {amount:float}, c."CURRENCY", {supporting_ref:string}, LEFT('Evidence: ' || {evidence:string}, 1900), CONVERT_TIMEZONE('Europe/London', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())::TIMESTAMP_NTZ, CURRENT_DATE(), 1 FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_CLAIMS c WHERE c."CLAIM_ID" = {claim_id:string} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_USERS u WHERE u."USER_NAME" = {acting_as:string} AND u."CAN_WRITE" = 'Y' AND u."ROLE" IN ('Finance (Recovery)'))

Submit Case for Review.description: Analyst records notes and evidence references and submits the case for controller review (Assigned/Returned → Submitted for review). Demo writeback target.

statements.sql: UPDATE ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_CLOSE_CASES SET "STATUS" = 'Submitted for review', "NOTES" = {notes:string}, "EVIDENCE_REFS" = {evidence_refs:string}, "DISPOSITION" = {disposition:string}, "UPDATED_BY" = {acting_as:string}, "UPDATED_AT" = CONVERT_TIMEZONE('Europe/London', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())::TIMESTAMP_NTZ WHERE "CASE_ID" = {case_id:string} AND "STATUS" IN ('Assigned', 'Returned', 'Open') AND LENGTH(TRIM({evidence_refs:string})) > 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_USERS u WHERE u."USER_NAME" = {acting_as:string} AND u."CAN_WRITE" = 'Y' AND u."ROLE" IN ('Royalty Analyst') AND (u."BRANCH_SCOPE" = 'ALL' OR CONTAINS(u."BRANCH_SCOPE", (SELECT s."BRANCH" FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_CLOSE_CASES c JOIN ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_STATEMENTS s USING ("STATEMENT_ID") WHERE c."CASE_ID" = {case_id:string}))))
statements.name: submit

statements.sql: INSERT INTO ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_CLOSE_EVENTS SELECT 'EV-' || UUID_STRING(), c."CASE_ID", c."STATEMENT_ID", 'Submitted for review', '', 'Submitted for review', {acting_as:string}, (SELECT MAX("ROLE") FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_USERS WHERE "USER_NAME" = {acting_as:string}), c."OBSERVED_AMOUNT", c."OBSERVED_CURRENCY", LEFT({disposition:string} || ' · evidence: ' || {evidence_refs:string}, 1900), CONVERT_TIMEZONE('Europe/London', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())::TIMESTAMP_NTZ, CURRENT_DATE(), 1 FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_CLOSE_CASES c WHERE c."CASE_ID" = {case_id:string} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_USERS u WHERE u."USER_NAME" = {acting_as:string} AND u."CAN_WRITE" = 'Y' AND u."ROLE" IN ('Royalty Analyst') AND (u."BRANCH_SCOPE" = 'ALL' OR CONTAINS(u."BRANCH_SCOPE", (SELECT s."BRANCH" FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_CLOSE_CASES c JOIN ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.ROYALTY_STATEMENTS s USING ("STATEMENT_ID") WHERE c."CASE_ID" = {case_id:string}))))
